item.title: The iPhone 17e feels like a plate of warmed-up leftovers
item.description: The iPhone 17e has arrived and if I’m not underwhelmed, it’s fair to say that I’m not overwhelmed either. Whelmed might reasonably describe my response. For months I’ve been following the rumours and, to be fair to the leakers and tipsters, most were right on the money – to the extent that there wasn’t one thing that Apple announced that was a surprise, except for the new, pale pink colourway. item.title: Ghosts, the fan-favourite British TV series, is getting a film sequel
item.description: If you thought it was time to say goodbye to the ghosts of Button House once and for all, you’re sorely mistaken. The BBC comedy show about a couple living in a haunted house is returning as a feature. Ghosts: The Possession of Button House is written by Mathew Baynton, Simon Farnaby, Martha Howe-Douglas, Jim Howick, Laurence Rickard and Ben Willbond, the writers and creators of the original Ghosts TV series. item.title: Confirmed: Oppo Find X9 Ultra European release date is “very soon”
item.description: Oppo just dropped a bombshell about its upcoming flagship phone. The company’s CEO for Europe, Elvis Zhou, confirmed that the rumoured Oppo Find X9 Ultra is going to be released internationally, and that includes Europe. “I’m excited to announce that this year, Oppo Find X9 Ultra will launch in Europe,” said Zhou, at the tail end of a presentation to media during Mobile World Congress 2026, in Barcelona. item.title: The OnePlus 15T is looking more and more impressive
item.description: The forthcoming OnePlus 15T is looking less and less like a compromised ‘almost-flagship’, and more like a compact power house. We learned last week that the OnePlus 15T was officially “Coming Soon”, though we’re sceptical of its chances of a wider release. That’s a shame, because it’s shaping up to be a spectacular phone. item.title: Samsung is ditching its own chip for the next Galaxy Watch
item.description: The next Samsung Galaxy Watch will ditch the company’s own silicon and switch to Qualcomm’s new off-the-shelf Snapdragon Wear Elite chip. Qualcomm just announced its new Snapdragon Wear Elite chip at MWC 2026 in Barcelona, promising a significant increase in performance for smartwatches and other wearables. item.description: The first Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra rumour is here, and it relates to the 2027 flagship phone’s likely camera specification. item.title: The Vivo X300 Ultra will launch globally – looks more camera than phone
item.description: Vivo has demonstrated its new flagship smartphone, the X300 Ultra, at MWC 2026 – and it’s shaping up to be a bit of a photographic monster. We don’t always afford Vivo too much coverage here on Tech Advisor, since their support for the UK and other Western markets has been spotty to say the least. item.title: Stock Android vs manufacturer skins: What’s the real difference?
item.description: Ask anyone what “stock Android” is and their answer would likely be that it’s a clean mobile interface without bloatware or imposed design changes. That simplicity explains why it appeals to so many users – as a concept, at least. In reality, most Android phones don’t run software like this. Not exactly.
